---
title: "Normal Distribution of IQ"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(x1, subscript(x, 1L))
hook(x2, subscript(x, 2L))

task <- "llnorm2"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  x1 <- sample(80:100, 1)
  x2 <- sample(100:120, 1)
  
  if (x2 - x1 > 10)
    next

  Q <- quote(search(llnorm2, llnorm2(x1, x2), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(
  t$correct, t$explanations, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra
)
```

Question
========

The intelligence quotient (IQ) has the property that in the general population it has mean $\mu$ = 100 and standard deviation $\sigma$ = 15.
What proportion of the population has an IQ between `r x1`  and `r x2`? [in %]

```{r questionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The proportion is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```

Meta-information
================
extype: schoice
exsolution: `r mchoice2string(t$correct, single=TRUE)`
